definitions.explanation: A component kept in stock or ordered to replace a worn, broken, or defective part in a machine, device, or vehicle.

examples.japanese: {交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機種|きしゅ}→機種：13211_kishu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Replacement parts for this model are no longer available.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{工賃|こうちん}→工賃：23036_kouchin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{別途|べっと}→別途：11881_betto⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The repair will incur separate costs for the replacement part and labor.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧ (exchange; replacement) and ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧ (parts; components). Used in maintenance, repair, and manufacturing contexts. Essential vocabulary when dealing with car maintenance, appliance repair, or technical support in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{寄|よ}せる→取り寄せる：26804_toriyoseru⟧: to order a replacement part
- {交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧: replacement parts inventory
- ⟦{純正|じゅんせい}→純正：21689_junsei⟧{交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}: genuine replacement parts
- {交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧: cost of replacement parts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スペア⟦パーツ→パーツ：11272_paatsu⟧: spare parts — loanword, often used in automotive contexts
- ⟦{予備|よび}{部品|ぶひん}→予備部品：25108_yobibuhin⟧: spare parts — parts kept in reserve as backup
- ⟦{消耗品|しょうもうひん}→消耗品：09548_shoumouhin⟧: consumable parts — parts designed to be replaced regularly through normal use
